pages.text: Every multiblock drifts: its ideal setting (or, for the physics machines, the disturbance it fights) wanders while it runs, and its containment wears. A $(item)Stabiliser$() used on the controller fights that for good.

$(li)$(item)Phase-Locked Stabiliser$(): 40% less drift, 1.5x longer between drift steps, 30% less wear and damage.$(li)$(item)Adaptive Feedback Core$(): 65% less drift, 2.5x longer between steps, 55% less wear.$(li)$(item)Predictive Lattice Governor$(): 88% less drift, 4x longer between steps, 80% less wear.

Only one perfect stabiliser exists: the $(item)Equilibrium Lattice$(), forged at the rebuilt Omnipotence Core. A machine holding it never drifts, never wears, never quenches and never faults - set it once and leave it. A better stabiliser replaces a lesser one, and the old one is handed back.
